title: In situ detection of the eIF4F translation initiation complex in mammalian cells
author: Shen, Girault, et al.
materials: High background or non-specific staining in nuclei.

steps.title: Autoclave and dry cover glasses
steps.instruction: Place 12 mm cover glasses in a 100 mm glass Petri dish, autoclave them, then dry at 37 °C in a heating oven for 16–24 h.

steps.title: Place cover glasses in plate
steps.instruction: Put two sterile 12 mm cover glasses into each well of a six‑well culture plate; ensure final cell confluency will not exceed 70 % (ideally ≤ 60 %).

steps.title: Seed cells onto cover glasses
steps.instruction: Add 2 × 10⁵ cells in 2 mL of culture medium to each well. For new cell lines, perform a serial dilution (1 × 10⁴, 5 × 10⁴, 1 × 10⁵, 2 × 10⁵ cells per well) and estimate proliferation after 16 h to choose the optimal seeding density.

steps.title: Allow attachment and incubate cells
steps.instruction: Leave the plate in the biosafety hood for 5 min with minimal vibrations to let cells attach, then incubate 24 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Verify cell distribution before treatment
steps.instruction: Inspect wells under a microscope; confirm homogeneous cell distribution with no clusters before any drug or perturbation treatment.

steps.title: Export microscopy images to TIFF
steps.instruction: Convert acquired images to TIFF format for analysis.

substeps.instruction: If images are from an Olympus Virtual Slide scanner (VSI format), view with OlyVIA and use the BIOP‑tool plugin (http://biop.epfl.ch/TOOL_VSI_Reader.html) to export TIFF files.
If images are from a Leica TCS SPE confocal microscope (already TIFF), open the DAPI and Cy5 channels as sequential stacks in ImageJ and save the stacks as TIFF.

steps.title: Process images for relative spot quantification
steps.instruction: Use ImageJ to convert TIFFs to binary and segment PLA spots.

substeps.instruction: Open TIFF, then select Process → Binary → Make Binary.
Apply Process → Binary → Watershed to segment spots.
Optionally run Process → Binary → Find Maxima to remove edge maxima and background.
Count spots; report median ± standard deviation from four independent images.

steps.title: Quantify absolute spots with FISH‑Quant
steps.instruction: Use the MATLAB‑based FISH‑Quant software (Mueller et al., 2013) for three‑dimensional spot counting.

substeps.instruction: Download demo images and software setup from https://sites.google.com/site/translationcomplexeif4f.
Run FISH‑Quant according to its manual to obtain absolute numbers of translation initiation complexes per cell.
